tiles.name: Containers running
tiles.exec: out=$(docker ps -q) || exit 1; printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -c . ; true

tiles.name: Container health
tiles.exec: u=$(docker ps -q --filter health=unhealthy) && r=$(docker ps -q --filter status=restarting) && e=$(docker ps -aq --filter status=dead) || exit 1; n() { printf '%s\n' "$1" | grep -c . ; true; }; u=$(n "$u"); r=$(n "$r"); e=$(n "$e"); if [ $((u + r + e)) -gt 0 ]; then echo "bad $u unhealthy · $r restarting · $e dead"; else echo "ok nothing unhealthy"; fi

tiles.name: Images
tiles.exec: out=$(docker images -q) || exit 1; printf '%s\n' "$out" | sort -u | grep -c . ; true
